requirements.description: AXI4 write-commit visibility (m_axi_bvalid && m_axi_bready before AR prefetch), unhandshaked BVALID immunity, zero-latency B-response burst-length integrity, and >32-deep response-FIFO overflow backpressure.
End-to-end sts_fifo_empty and sts_fifo_occupancy tracking across ingress encoder, write FIFO, DRAM ring/in-flight AXI bursts, read/ctrl FIFOs, and stalled egress decoder.

Single-cycle and multi-cycle cfg_reset flush handshake across equal/asynchronous clocks with clean AXI4 burst termination, zero stale fragment leakage, and cfg_fifo_base_addr/cfg_fifo_size_mask updates.
Safe segment watermark flow-control margin under sustained AXI backpressure plus latch/loop-free synthesis and initializer-stripped gate-level Zero-X simulation.
